args: PORT=9222; curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/json/version >/dev/null 2>&1 || { CHROME=$(ls -d /opt/pw-browsers/chromium-*/chrome-linux/chrome 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -1); [ -n "$CHROME" ] || CHROME=$(command -v google-chrome || command -v google-chrome-stable || command -v chromium || command -v chromium-browser); nohup "$CHROME" --headless=new --no-sandbox --disable-gpu --remote-debugging-port=$PORT --user-data-dir=/tmp/cdmcp-profile >/tmp/cdmcp-chrome.log 2>&1 & for i in $(seq 1 50); do curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/json/version >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 0.3; done; }; exec npx -y chrome-devtools-mcp@latest --browser-url http://127.0.0.1:$PORT --no-usage-statistics --allow-unrestricted-paths

D=/tmp/mcp-cache/mcp-game-helper; [ -f "$D/dist/index.js" ] || { mkdir -p /tmp/mcp-cache; rm -rf "$D"; git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/xhulz/mcp-game-helper "$D" >/tmp/mcp-mgh.log 2>&1 && cd "$D" && npm install --no-audit --no-fund >>/tmp/mcp-mgh.log 2>&1 && npm run build >>/tmp/mcp-mgh.log 2>&1; }; exec node "$D/dist/index.js"

D="${GAME_ASSET_MCP_DIR:-$HOME/.mcp-cache/game-asset-mcp}"; [ -f "$D/src/index.js" ] || { mkdir -p "$(dirname "$D")"; git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/MubarakHAlketbi/game-asset-mcp "$D" && ( cd "$D" && npm install --no-audit --no-fund ); }; exec node "$D/src/index.js"
